assets._pool: USDC's deepest native-HYPE v4 pool with no hook (Nov 10 scan): 0.3% / 60, about 27,300 HYPE and 2.0M USDC in range. The router trades USDC against HYPE through it, and through HYPE against every launch and outside token (two pools, one private swap).

ecosystem._note: Outside tokens (CloakEcosystemVault). Fixed at deploy: a token needs the Safe's proposal, a plain native-HYPE v4 pool (no hook) with at least minHypeLiquidity HYPE in range, a market cap of at least minMcapHype HYPE, caps at most maxPerDepositBps / maxTotalBps of its supply, and admitDelaySecs before admit() checks it all again.

tokens._token: KNTQ on Elysium mainnet (Kinetiq Governance Token, 18 decimals, not a proxy), found in the Nov 10 pool scan. Kinetiq's docs list 0x0000...c2d6, which is KNTQ on HyperEVM and has no code on Elysium.
tokens._pool: KNTQ's deepest native-HYPE v4 pool with no hook: 0.3% fee, tick spacing 60, about 30,200 HYPE and 5.6M KNTQ in range on Nov 10. Others: 1% / 200 (about 28,000 HYPE), 0.8% / 120 (about 5,500 HYPE).
tokens._caps: 5 and 50 bps of the Elysium supply: about 6,500 KNTQ per deposit and 65,000 KNTQ in total.

ecosystem._minMcapHype: The market cap counts the token's supply on Elysium only (a bridged token's Elysium supply, not its full supply): KNTQ, with about 13.0M KNTQ on Elysium at about 186 KNTQ per HYPE, is about 69,900 HYPE (scan of Nov 10). 50,000 HYPE is about $3.7M at HYPE near $73.
